official_measurement_examples.name: Large raised reservoir threshold
official_measurement_examples.fact: Current England guidance uses more than 25,000 cubic metres stored above ground level for the large-raised-reservoir regulatory threshold.

official_measurement_examples.name: Reservoir reform inventory
official_measurement_examples.fact: The March 2026 reform programme reports 2,146 large raised reservoirs in England as of March 2025.

official_measurement_examples.name: Reservoir flood-map scenarios
official_measurement_examples.fact: EA reservoir flood maps distinguish dry-day and wet-day dam-failure scenarios.

official_measurement_examples.name: Inspection interval
official_measurement_examples.fact: Owner guidance says inspecting engineers carry out an inspection at least once every 10 years for the relevant regulated reservoirs.

official_measurement_examples.name: Emergency-plan requirement
official_measurement_examples.fact: All undertakers of large raised reservoirs in England must prepare an on-site emergency flood plan.

official_measurement_examples.name: Extreme-weather guidance date
official_measurement_examples.fact: EA published reservoir extreme-weather resilience guidance on 8 September 2025.

official_measurement_examples.name: Incident final-report window
official_measurement_examples.fact: EA incident guidance gives operators 12 months to investigate and submit the final incident report after a reportable reservoir safety incident.

official_measurement_examples.name: Reform programme scope
official_measurement_examples.fact: The 2026 reform programme is phased over several years and does not itself replace current statutory duties.

core_rules: reservoir registration is not planning permission
large-raised-reservoir threshold is not a parcel flood-risk threshold
high-risk reservoir designation is not a probability of dam failure
not-high-risk designation is not zero risk
reservoir flood map is a modelled emergency scenario not an observed flood event
dry-day extent is not an exact future inundation boundary
wet-day extent is not an exact future inundation boundary
reservoir flood-map intersection is not automatic planning refusal
reservoir flood maps must not be used in isolation for strategic allocation decisions
site-specific FRA may need additional modelling beyond the national reservoir map
reservoir owner consultation is not owner consent to development
LPA emergency-planning consultation is not planning permission
on-site emergency flood plan is not an off-site emergency plan
off-site emergency plan is not a planning approval
emergency-plan existence is not proof the reservoir is safe for all downstream development
panel-engineer certification of a flood plan is not planning permission
supervising engineer appointment is not an engineering approval of nearby development
inspecting engineer report is not a parcel development certificate
inspection interval is not evidence that an inspection happened on a specific date
measures in the interests of safety must not be assumed complete without evidence
reservoir incident report is not proof of current unsafe condition after remediation
absence of a reported incident is not proof of no defects
incident hotline report is not a validated reservoir failure event
EA investigation of a concern is not a planning enforcement action
reservoir reform programme is not current site-specific regulation beyond enacted duties
future reform proposals must not be backdated
national reservoir counts are not local risk counts
people-potentially-at-risk statistics must not be downscaled to a parcel
extreme-weather guidance is not a site resilience assessment
climate projections are not exact reservoir operating forecasts
spillway capacity must not be inferred from reservoir size
dam condition must not be inferred from imagery
reservoir volume must not be fabricated from mapped surface area
reservoir ownership must not be inferred from the water polygon
reservoir registration record is distinct from land ownership
building or modifying a reservoir can require separate planning and environmental permissions
reservoir safety approval is not environmental permit
environmental permit is not reservoir-safety certification
abstraction or impoundment licence is not planning permission
discontinuance or abandonment analysis is not permission to remove a reservoir
repurposing option scoring is not project consent
reservoir safety and ordinary flood-zone risk must remain distinct
reservoir flood risk and coastal flood risk must remain distinct
source date and model assumptions must be preserved
NO_DATA must not become no reservoir constraint
research confidence is not parcel reservoir-risk accuracy
no parcel reservoir clearance flood depth or Future Growth score may be promoted while recovery is parked
business rows remain zero until canonical recovery completes
